summary: Frontend-only validation of MOOD V2 Phases 1-3 against preview URL. All 7 requested flows PASS after restarting expo to invalidate a stale Metro bundle. Verified: (1) ForceUpdateGate non-blocking, (2) FoundingOfferModal renders correctly for founding_tester with FOUNDING MEMBER eyebrow, 'You helped build MOOD.' headline, '$39/year, locked forever.' price, 'Claim within 14 days' countdown, 'Claim Founding Price — $39/year' CTA, 'Remind me later' link, (3) Remind me later dismisses modal and reaches home, (4) Claim flow on web calls POST /api/me/claim-founding (200) and closes modal without error, (5) moodtester (non-founding) sees NO founding modal and entitlement endpoint is called, (6) NEW signup via Register screen lands DIRECTLY on /onboarding-funnel/step-1-mood (mood selection 1/8) as required by Phase 3.1, (7) No white-screen/crash, login works, navigation works. Important encountered tooling issue: Metro/Expo dev server was serving a STALE bundle that still contained the V1 'WELCOME BACK / You're a Founding Member / no charge, no expiration / Continue' modal even though FoundingMemberGate.tsx source no longer contains that code. A `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` recompiled the bundle and V2 content now renders. Main agent should be aware that when modifying source files served by Expo CI-mode Metro, a service restart may be needed. Deprecated packages still detected in expo logs: expo-av (warned: deprecated; migrate to expo-audio / expo-video).

react_native_issues.issue: Expo AV is deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Migrate to expo-audio (audio) and expo-video (video). Seen in expo startup log: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54.'

action_items: Migrate expo-av usages to expo-audio and expo-video (deprecated package warning surfaces on every Expo start).

Optional: document a 'restart expo to flush Metro cache' note for testers — Metro in CI mode (reloads disabled) can serve a stale bundle when source files change; this caused the V1 founding modal to appear before the restart in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: FoundingOfferModal, FoundingMemberGate, register.tsx all match the V2 spec. Wiring through SubscriptionContext + AuthContext (refreshEntitlement now correctly passes Authorization header) is functioning end-to-end.
Register flow correctly calls router.replace('/onboarding-funnel/step-1-mood') and gates submission behind the medical/ToS acknowledgement checkbox.
Claim flow hits POST /api/me/claim-founding optimistically on web (no native StoreKit) and closes modal cleanly.
seed_data_creation: Registered 1 new user during Phase 3.1 routing test: username=v2t<timestamp>, email=v2test+<timestamp>@example.com. Founding tester's founding_pricing_claimed flag is now TRUE in DB after the successful Claim test — to retest the claim flow it must be reset via backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1-3 flows verified on web. If retesting the founding claim modal, reset founding_pricing_claimed for founding_tester in MongoDB first (it was set to true during this iteration). Metro CI-mode may require `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` if source changes don't appear in the served bundle.
rca_of_issue: RCA (encountered + auto-mitigated): On first run, the FoundingOfferModal appeared as the V1 legacy modal ('WELCOME BACK / You're a Founding Member / Premium access for as long as the app exists / Continue'). Inspecting the served Expo dev bundle confirmed it still contained that V1 string (mapped to /app/frontend/components/FoundingMemberGate.tsx via _jsxFileName) even though the current source file no longer contains it. Root cause: Metro is running in CI mode ('Metro is running in CI mode, reloads are disabled' — per expo.out.log) so file changes during the iteration weren't re-bundled. Mitigation: `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` recompiled the bundle; subsequent fetch confirmed V1 text count=0 and V2 strings ('You helped build MOOD', 'Claim Founding Price', 'locked forever') count=1 each. After restart, all 7 test scenarios passed.
